"''Copy that, General. We're going in.|[[Mace Windu]] and Gold leader during the Battle of Anaxes|}} "'''Gold Leader'''" was the [[callsign]] of a [[clone trooper pilot]] who served as [[commander]] of the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wing]] [[Squadron|unit]] [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Anaxes]]. During the battle, Gold Leader led an attack run on the [[Anaxes assembly complex]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== In the original unfinished version of "[[Unfinished Business (episode)|Unfinished Business]]," released in [[2015]], Gold Leader wears the same clone pilot uniform and face-revealing [[flight helmet]] as the clone pilots seen in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].{{SW|url=video/unfinished-business-star-wars-the-clone-wars-story-reel|text="Unfinished Business" - Star Wars: The Clone Wars Story Reel|nolive=1}} However, in the final version of the episode released on [[Disney+]] in [[2020]], he wears the standard [[Phase II clone trooper armor|Phase II]] pilot armor. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Unfinished Business (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/unfinished-business-episode-guide|text="Unfinished Business" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Clone trooper officers]] [[Category:Clone trooper pilots]] [[Category:Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic) personnel]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
